question: Point out which of the following is a characteristic of cerebellar ataxia:

options.opc: The imbalance worsens when the patient closes his eyes (Romberg + sign).

analysis: Cerebellar ataxia is characterized by a lack of coordination and control of voluntary movements due to dysfunction of the cerebellum. One of the classic features of cerebellar ataxia is the worsening of imbalance when the patient closes their eyes, known as the Romberg sign.
